message: Good morning. Two things came back to life overnight: Todoist is reachable again, and WHOOP synced at 8:31 for the first time since June — recovery 67%, sleep 76%. Everything below is live data, not yesterday's guesses.

Here's what the live list actually says: the four SETUP tasks are still open, 27 days overdue. The dashboard has been counting 'Day 29 of 150' while Day 1 — the baseline footage — has never been filmed. That's the hardest thing today, and the one action is simple: put the phone on a tripod at a track and film the tests. Two hours.

It's Thursday, so the rhythm says SHOOT 2 — I've written today's checklist into 💀 Daily: batch 8–12 shorts, post two reels, count the bank. Recovery at 67% is decent; today was also the end of the 'nothing maximal until 3 Sept' window, but the ramp never went on the calendar, so treat sprinting as still gated.

Two bills went overdue while Todoist was dark — Fitness Passports $69 (28 Aug) and Car Insurance $58 (1 Sep), both tagged Karin. And a decision I need from you: keep 6 Aug as the start date and accept the gap, or reset Day 1 to this weekend and I rebuild the plan?
